title: Claude Code: Message your other Claude Code sessions
summary: Claude lists sessions with ListAgents and sends plain text with SendMessage. Sessions on one machine talk over a per-session socket; sessions on other machines and cloud sessions are reached through Anthropic's servers while the sending session is connected to Remote Control. A cloud session cannot reply with SendMessage to a message from another machine; its answer is read in its transcript. A message is never the user's consent, cannot run commands or change configuration. notify_when_idle asks a local session for one notice when it next goes idle. Limits: plain text, about a million characters, burst and loop throttling.
ideas: avenMAIA can reach every intent's cloud thread by name from a local session connected to Remote Control.
Replies from cloud threads come back by reading their transcripts, not as messages.
A message cannot pass a gate: only Samuel's own words count as consent.
